
Hello and welcome to another exciting installment of Tales of Terra-Nova I am your humble dungeon master and you are my intrepid heroes, say hi intrepid heroes! In our previous session we fought in the Iron Maw fighting pit, we met Mykoz Tythos, we defeated Valen Drakovar, nearly destroyed Bloodwing the vampiric dragon, and managed to escape to the Ivory Spire with Talinor and Essek! Jerome Darksteel was captured by Scarlett Rex, and our friend Antigone was invited to join her and their mother one last time, while the rest of you were invited to die in Veinspire Castle.

We find ourselves in Talinor's office once again, as he lore dumps everything he has ever know to you. Soft and seemingly harmless earthquakes echo through the cave at irregular intervals. You can hear the sounds of the city alive below you through the windows in the office. There are cots and sleeping bags for people to take a long rest on, it's about 10pm.

Before you go to sleep Talinor responds tot he question you posed last session, combing through one of his books on celestial creatures:
- "Ivys you asked about Prime Creations... I had thought that I was unaware of the term before, but I seem to have jogged my memory with this text although I can't quite determine much about them."
- "I have found information on a couple creatures. Sylvaris, a forest spirit of some kind, and Aurathia, a lake spirit. I believe Sylvaris is in an underground cave network of mass biological scale called "The Caves of Seline Thrimai", and Aurathia has been mentioned to reside on the waters of Lake Irath."
- "You're looking for these creatures? Best of luck, from what I have read they're quite dangerous, especially this Sylvaris, the caves of Seline Thrimai are overgrown and full of dangerous insects. Best of luck there."
- "As far as I can tell they're mystical beings of dubious origin, and they're generally isolated and hostile. I wish you the best of luck on that front."
- "Emrys, if I could have a moment? I am... sorry. I was a bit rude. I was correct, but I was harsh. I come from a religious background myself and its sometimes difficult to express proper empathy to others who remind me o myself, so for that I am sorry."
- "I'm quite tired, I'm headed to bed. There's a study hall down and on the left, first door. It locks and its soundproof in and out, you're welcome to it if you need some privacy. Have a good evening."


## Some downtime
They can RP, talk more, plan, and then take a long rest. Prepare for Emrys to pray to or try to contact Aldred. [[Emrys Development]]

As you all sit around the small fireplace in the office, your cots pulled near to remain warm in the cold caves of Ironpetal, you are free to talk and theorize, or plan or strategize. 
Talinor is aware of [[Brother Tarot]], says his name is actually Korach Tarot, and he used to be a follower of Mani and Elena Syrell before he went to preach the word of the Punisher a year ago, people believe he can see the future as he preached Aldred's word before his ascension. He is a kind and charitable man.

As you sit around the fire, Ivys begins to reminisce about his time as a student, thinking back to his first mission with Egreth on the seas of Konduell's Grasp. [[Ivys and the Verdant Portal]]


## ESCAPE THE IVORY SPIRE
After a while, they all gain the benefits of a long rest, but are awakened by massive tremors. They have gotten much stronger since they went to sleep, and when they wake up the entire spire is shaking. Talinor falls out of his bed and looks around confused as the room shakes. Melvin pops its head out of his collar and squeaks something to him, "We need to leave now. This whole place is about to come down."

If they don't get out of the Ivory spire they may be trapped or worse.
They fight their way through the halls beams and stones are crashing down around them. Everyone make a Dexterity saving throw to avoid the falling rubble and debris. (DC 14, 1d8 bludgeoning)
You run through the cramped hallways of the academy, following Talinor as he screams directions. "LEFT HERE, RIGHT, RIGHT, DOWN THOSE STAIRS QUICKLY!"

You sprint down the stairs dodging as much damage as you can, and enter into a large red carpeted room. One by one you enter the room and gather, Talinor looks around confused, "Wait, this isn't he library, hm. I meant to take us to the Rockrunner stables... ah yes we made a wrong turn by the Weave charging chambers..." As he rambles about directions another massive boulder comes tumbling down towards you all, including Talinor, and he is completely oblivious. Make a Dexterity saving throw. (DC 16, 2d8 bludgeoning damage)

He leads you around a corner and to a small reading nook, funneling people inside and screaming to the first person in, "PULL THE RED BOOK!"

### WRITE A SMALL PATH FROM HERE TO THE LIBRARY WITH A PUZZLE

As you make your way down winding halls and secret caverns you reach what appears to be the back of a bookshelf, its heavy wood shelves lined with tomes in front of you. A glittering magic wall besides you glows with the words, "Speak my name: What has 13 hearts but no body or soul?"

Talinor doesn't remember the answer but does know that the secret tunnels were built by Lorekeeper [[Castador]], who was known to be a prankster and loved to be tricky.

The answer is a deck of cards! If they get the right answer the bookshelf opens and they enter the Library, where they can see many levels above them are breaking, and a few large boulders shatter and crash on the catwalks above sending dust and stones down their way. They have a few moments to breathe.

Another loud roar echoes through he halls, all the way from the depths of the city and beyond... Essek looks up at Emrys and Reister, "Did you feel that? Something very bad, and very Abyssal is happening. We need to go NOW!"
As he says now a laugh is heard across the library, through the door at the opposite end of the room enters a colossal blue Dragonborn. His lower Jaw is made of crude black metal, and he carries a massive axe, even larger than Drakovar's sword. He grunts at you as he drags his axe through the ground, shattering the ancient and ornate tiles of the library. He raises his axe and points it at you, mumbling as blood pours from his mouth, "Darksteel.... for ARKONIL RAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!" He charges forward, and you see two large red scaled drakes enter, prowling behind him and joining the charge, ROLL INITIATIVE!
[[Agamemnon]] attacks.

**Enemies**: [[agamemnon (1).png]], 2x [[redDrake.png]]

During combat, **Agamemnon** voice lines:
- "Hannibal say, you weak now, no war elf, NO SURVIVORS!!!!!!!"
- "I bring, fury, I am the thunder, I AM AGAMEMNONNNNNN!"
- "You cannot stop... the Reckoner... he will burn your cities! HE WILL DEFILE YOUR HOLY SITES! THE SCAR SPREADS! LASHES ACROSS MY MIND! HIS BLADE WILL CHOKE AND DARKEN THE SKY!"

During combat: (Choose a random player nearest to one of the walls aka the window)
An arrow wizzes past your head, just barely nicking your ear, you see it flew through a window from outside the spire. Blood begins to run down the side of your face, you take 3d6 piercing damage. (**Verrow**)

If Agamemnon gets in trouble, Zyrathia will arrive, teleporting him out and saying, "The Young Wolves! I would love to get my hands on one of you... a shame that your souls have been claimed by our Lord. You shall suffer his vengeance once he is done with the King. Until next time doggies."

Combat ends after Agamemnon dies or escapes and they kill the drakes.


## Continue to escape

As they run through the winding halls they see the exit, massive stones shatter in the archway and crash down, blocking the door. They need to find a way through.

The city outside is chaotic, people are running in panic, you can see from the steps of the Ivory spire, the city sprawling out almost entirely below you except for the spires, the gates are in ruins.. Winged creatures can be seen assailing the walls of the city. Demons from the Abyss have come to defile and lay waste to Ironpetal.
The people are in panic, amplified by the fact that Ivys said a portal to hell was attacking the city, fires rage, looting has begun, there is no semblance of law.

As you travel the streets, making the 20 minute walk to the Sunspire base, you see carriages of food, unguarded, torn from the arms of people, many citizens with weapons gather in areas, preparing to act a s local militia, the Calcite guard is nowhere to be seen.
A large mechanical elevator awaits you. Nobody is there to operate it, but there is a not on the lever that says, "Crank to go up until you reach the bridge, sorry, have to check on wife and children."

You head up the elevator to the top of the Sunspire, riding all the way from the bottom to the entrance of the Whispering Bridge, that which leads you to Veinspire Castle.


## Verrow's Hunt
As you traverse the city, dodging through people and chaos as you go, you reach the west market, the other massive market in the city, and what you need to get through to reach the Sunspire and the Whispering Bridge.

As you all stand in the courtyard, the massive beholder fountain that marks the entrance, you feel two more arrows shoot past your heads. They both aim towards the same person, one hits one misses, you take 3d6 piercing damage as an arrow hits your chest. For those who aren't hit, you can see the red wood of an abyssal tree protruding from your friends chest.

Roll Initiative!

Enemies: [[verrow.png]]
 - This battle is designed as a horror scene. They are trying to reach the Sunspire, Verrow is trying to kill one of theme with abyssal wood arrows (meaning they can't be brought back). Verrow is hunting them, and he stays hidden for almost the entire combat. He is able to go invisible, and will fire off 3 shots then move, causing chaos and panic in the party.
 - The best way to stop him is to create difficult terrain or somehow gain vision on him. They can make perception checks as actions to detect him, the DC is 18 to find him.
 - If Verrow gets gets detected he will disengage as fast as possible, he is looking for a kill not a fight.

They fight their way through the city and reach the lift where they can head up to the Whispering Bridge.


## Battle on the Whispering Bridge

As you ascend the lift, taking turns operating the arm of the mechanical elevator yourself, you eventually reach the bridge. Before you is an army of skeletons, clearly posted to prevent you from reaching Veinspire. They are led by a pair of vampires. 
This is it, an army of the dead versus the Young Wolves. We aren't rolling initiative, how do you guys wanna do this? This is your Thor on the bridge moment, just do some dope ass shit, combos, whatever you want! GO CRAZY!!!!!!!

After they defeat the massive number of skeletons they continue forward on the bridge reaching the halfway point, they see before them the dark purple and black of Veinspire Castle, its towers shattered by the earthquakes.
Before you awaits two familiar faces, Asphodel and Heskel. They stand in their dark robes, strangely their skin appears to be more red than pale, but still they bear the iconic red scythe symbol of House Rex.

Heskel steps forward and smiles, "It is good to see you again Lord Antigone. Your mother will be pleased you made it, though, you will need to come with us. The scar is growing, it will be getting quite dangerous here soon."

Asphodel pushes him to the side, placing her massive sword on her shoulder, "Enough talk, Antigone, come home. You will not survive the blood storm that comes if you stand with them. Take this last chance and live as you were meant to, with us." She holds out her open hand, inviting you to join them.

Heskel, "Just say the word, that's all you need to do. Just say it."

If they agree -> [[Antigone and Catherine]]

*Enemies*: 1x [[vampire priestess.png]], 1x [[vampiric knight.png]]
- From the Scar: As the scar lowers, the crackling red energy being visible on the roof of the cave, you see the form of devils and demons manifest and fly downwards, laying siege to all of the city, and falling down to the bridge is a gigantic black and red Abyssal Hound! 1x [[hound of the night.png]]
*Combat Lines*: 
- Heskel: "Tell me mortal, have you figured out which one of you it is yet?", "What do I mean? Hmm you Young Wolves are profoundly disappointing at every turn!"
- Asphodel: "I was sorry to hear about your little war champion. A shame, the things I heard are being done to her, were done, delicious mutilations! Come, I will show you how much blood you really have!"


## Darksteel's Tale

As you make your way towards the castle gates, standing tall and ominous, you notice off the the left, the crumpled bleeding body of a black dragonborn. 
Jerome Darksteel, barely alive, currently unconscious, his armor in tatters and no weapons to be found, lies near death beside the bridge. He is still alive but barely.
If they heal him:
- "Catherine, catacombs, now. Some kind of ritual and a machine. You need to get down there soon. It'll take a while but the city will collapse before she's finished. I'll go down to the city, get people out if I can. There's a way out in the Sunspire, secret tunnel. Get going! Be warned, Scarlett is inside, she's waiting for you."
- "She held me in the catacombs, did some experiments on my blood, wanted information on the demon rebirth... don't know why. You have a mission get to work, I'll get as many people out as I can."



## Enter the Dungeon

They make their way into [[Veinspire Castle]]

This session ends during or at the end of the Veinspire Castle dungeon.

**WHEN SESSION NEEDS TO END**: You all feel a faint vibration in the floor, the precursor to a much larger incoming quake. "EVERYONE HOLD ONTO SOMETHING!" As you grab hold of anything you can find you feel a terrible quake rumble through the castle. Items fall from shelves, the floor cracks and tears in places. Make a Dexterity Saving Throw (DC 19) on a failure you are knocked prone and hurled into things, taking 2d6 bludgeoning damage. On a success half as much.
As you steady yourselves you look out through one of the castle windows and see a massive chunk of stone from the roof of the cave, fall from its height and land directly in the Western City Market. 
The city around you is collapsing, the Young Wolves are running out of time... and that's where we end tonight's session!
